_about: Boss data for Maple Wordle. Source: maplestorywiki.net (Oct 2026). Normal/Hard modes use each boss's hardest non-Extreme mode (Hard > Chaos > Normal > Easy; Gollux = Hell). Extreme mode lists every difficulty as its own entry. hp = sum of all phase HP. level = entry level. Story mode uses the normal pool with unlimited guesses. null = still missing.

notes.Gollux: HP = 3 Head phases only. Wiki only lists the 180+ requirement, so every mode uses 180
notes.Cygnus: Removed from KMS in the Overdrive update
notes.Malicia: ESTIMATE: wiki only has Phase 3 HP, so all 4 phases are assumed equal to it
notes.Kaling: P1 = 3 perils, P2 = Kaling, P3 = 3 perils + Frenzied Kaling
notes.Kai: Challenger World seasonal boss; World set to Other (Nexus Tower)
notes.Meilin: NOT ON WIKI - need world, gender, phases, HP, level
notes.Balrog: Only Easy mode exists; HP = body + 2 extra parts
notes.Yakuza Boss: Level is monster level (no entry level listed)
notes.Frenzied Gigatoad: HP is 900M in GMS; level is monster level
notes.Extreme Bigfoot: Monster Park Extreme; level is monster level
notes.Pianus: Classic Cave of Pianus version; level is monster level
notes.Krexel: Ulu City; level is monster level
notes.Scarlion & Targa: Both bosses summed; phases = normal/angry/furious forms; level is monster level
notes.Ravana: Golden Temple; level is monster level
notes.Nibelung: Monster Park; level is monster level
notes.Reina: Arteria quest boss; level is monster level
notes.Cross: Removed JMS/TMS boss. Wiki has no HP/level/phases
notes.Normal Inferno Wolf: Bounty portal boss (Lv 10-199). Wiki has no HP
notes.Chaos Inferno Wolf: Bounty portal boss (Lv 200-259). Wiki has no HP
notes.Extreme Inferno Wolf: Bounty portal boss (Lv 260+). Wiki has no HP
notes.Inferno Wolf #4: Wiki only lists 3 Inferno Wolf types - which is the 4th?
notes.Gerand Darmoor: Story NPC page only, no monster stats on wiki
notes.Havoc: Story NPC page only, no monster stats on wiki
